# btfilter.sys ![:inline](/images/twitter_verified.png) 

### Description

A vulnerable kernel driver that can be used to disable Code Integrity
- **UUID**: 7d4439c5-1ee3-4297-99ea-bb7eab3c256c
- **Created**: 2026-10-25
- **Author**: Andrea Monzani
- **Acknowledgement**: Andrea Monzani, Davide Netti, Antonio Parata | [](https://twitter.com/)

{{< button "https://github.com/magicsword-io/LOLDrivers/raw/main/drivers/b655e2e9a50e1db45ea492ae1025390f.bin" "Download" >}}
{{< tip "warning" >}}
This download link contains the vulnerable driver!

{{< /tip >}}

{{< blockbanner "btfilter.sys" >}}
### Commands

```
sc.exe create btfilter binPath=C:\windows\temp\btfilter.sys type=kernel &amp;&amp; sc.exe start btfilter
```


| Use Case | Privileges | Operating System | 
|:---- | ---- | ---- |
| Elevate privileges | kernel | Windows 10 |
